_completedRetentionDays: Days a completed item is kept before it is deleted. Any number, 0 deletes immediately.
_reportedPriorities: Priorities that color the sidebar icon and tab dots. Any of: none, normal, medium, high.
_sortAfterPriority: Order of items within the same priority. One of: createdAsc (oldest first), createdDesc (newest first), titleAsc (A to Z), titleDesc (Z to A).
